note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), read offline from the bundled owb-am text, per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. Every quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim, replacing the 1962 UBS wording and the OT renderings made in its register: the twelve chapter epigraphs, Spurgeon's quoted verses, and the verse recited without marks (Ezekiel 36:26 in chapter 4).

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse or range, or the shortest span carrying the quoted clause. `self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions, Spurgeon's own applications, and the prayers and replies the reader is given in their own words.

Family consistency: every verse this edition shares with the full all-of-grace.am (re-quoted to OWB in #9959) uses the same OWB span and the same recurring-word calls. Romans 4:5 is OWB «እግዚአብሔርን የማይፈሩትን በሚያጸድቅ», glossed once in chapter 2 (ማለትም እግዚአብሔር ኃጢአተኛውን ያጸድቃል), and the author's prose keeps ኃጢአተኛ (decision justifieth-the-ungodly). Romans 5:6 is OWB «ገና አቅመ ቢሶች ሳለን …» (decision without-strength); the chapter's closing reply keeps OWB's words in the first person and is self_rendered. Isaiah 45:22 is OWB «ወደ እኔ ዞር በሉና ድኑ», and Spurgeon's 'I looked' became 'ዞር ብዬ ተመለከትሁ' (decision look-unto-me). John 3:7 is OWB «ከላይ መወለድ አለባችሁ», glossed once (ማለትም ዳግመኛ መወለድ). 'It is God that justifieth' is now cited as what it is, Romans 8:33 («የሚያጸድቃቸው እግዚአብሔር ነው»), not Romans 3:26. 1 Corinthians 1:8 'blameless' is OWB «ምንም ክስ እንዳይቀርብባችሁ». The English quotes the ESV; the epigraphs cite book and verse with no version label, as the Amharic teen editions do.
